notes.title: An update to optimize the character's skills
notes.content: Dandelion's evasion can now collide with enemy attacks and counterattack. Cinder King's ground basic attacks can now collide with enemy attacks and counterattack. At the same time, Embers King's block counterattack is easier to achieve.
